remarks_1999: Double entries Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive indicates, "Painted 1930. Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946 ... No signature [notes inscriptions 1, 2]. Note: Probably one of the 'Landscape Near H & M Ranch' in 1931 exh" [painting in 1931 exhibition not listed this way, see below]. Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold to General Mills Co. by Halpert, Dec. 1958." Pictured in 1931 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix figure 43. See cat. no. 1856. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Rust Red Hills

description: At the center of the composition stand layers of hills in various rich colors, from deep blue to burgundy. Small crags that resemble wrinkles interrupt the smoothness of the hills. A pale pink and yellow sky with tiny white clouds glows above the land.
title: Rust Red Hills
